_doc: How dimensions are written and drawn. Drawing conventions only, not design rules. unit: 'cm', 'm' or 'mm'. decimals: decimals shown; a value that is not whole at that many decimals gets one more (12.5 cm stays 12.5). measureTo: what the automatic 'rooms' chain measures between, 'faces' (clear room sizes and wall thicknesses) or 'centrelines' (wall axis to wall axis). The sizes below are millimetres on paper; on screen the plan is treated as if drawn at 1:screenScale. textHeightMm: height of the figures. firstChainMm: distance of the first chain from the building. chainSpacingMm: distance between chains. tickMm: length of the slanted stroke at each end of a dimension. extensionMm: how far lines run past the dimension line. textGapMm: gap between a figure and its line. roomInsetMm: how far a room's own dimension lines sit from its label and its wall.
